messages:
Emma: heads-up — planning a small pricing page experiment next week: surface the calculator higher, tweak tier names (Startup → Scale, Pro → Performance), update FAQ snippet for metering, and add 'Join webinar' vs 'Book demo' CTA tests. want quick sync. metrics: calc starts, demo rate, faq clicks, inbound routing. thoughts?

Josh: love it. can we include a control that keeps original tier names? want clean A/B. also set an experiment id and UTM. i'm worried about demo backlog if we route too many leads to SDR.

Leo: i can instrument. propose experiment_id=pc_vis_2024_06, utm=price_calc_v2. metric targets: +12% calc engagement, +5% qualified demos. will dashboard the funnel. need list of event names.

Anita: copy suggestions: CTA A: 'See your cost'  CTA B: 'Estimate cost & book a demo'  FAQ microcopy: add single-line answer for 'How do commitments affect pricing?' — i'll draft.

Emma: @Josh agree on control. routing idea: tiered routing — > high-estimated spend leads to SDR, low spend to self-serve email drip. can we do thresholds based on calc output? example: spend_est >= $2,000/mo -> SDR.

Josh: yes, route via HubSpot workflow. send payload with tags: 'calc_estimate', 'experiment:pc_vis_2024_06'. @Leo can you expose those fields in the events?

Leo: yep. I'll add `calc_estimate_usd` and `experiment` to analytics and to the webhook payload. sample payload: `{ amount: 2500, experiment: 'pc_vis_2024_06' }`

Emma: timeline: dev deploy Monday (A/B), live Tues-Weds for a 7-day run, quick check mid-run. webinar CTA variant to be promoted Wed, webinar scheduled Thu next week. Anita — can you draft webinar blurb + landing page snippet?

Anita: on it. webinar angle: 'How to minimize inference costs without sacrificing latency' — intro, bench metrics, calc walkthrough. will share copy by EOD.

deploy-bot (bot): deploy-bot: Pricing page A/B experiment 'pc_vis_2024_06' scheduled for 2024-06-11 10:00 UTC. PR: #4321

Leo: heads-up — baseline metrics attached in dashboard: calc_rate: 2.3%, demo_rate: 0.4%. will compare against cohorts. also adding an alert if demo_rate spikes >200% to avoid SDR overload.

Josh: :thumbsup: who owns post-experiment analysis writeup? marketing + analytics collab.

Emma: I'll collate results + lead gen numbers. postmortem doc in Notion; will ping once initial results in. thanks team!
